key_insight: Bellman Policy Optimization (BPO) converts Policy Mirror Descent into a trajectory-level objective for terminal-reward autoregressive generation, eliminating the need to estimate intermediate state values while preserving the same unique optimum.
engineering_relevance: BPO offers a simpler critic-free RLVR training recipe for LLM reasoning, making optimization more practical and potentially more stable for mathematical reasoning tasks.
method: Derive a trajectory-level objective from the Bellman equations for terminal rewards.
Avoid intermediate value-function estimation by optimizing directly over generated trajectories.
Use a practical BPO loss with a smoothed complementary-probability ratio as the mismatch-correction weight.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks, showing BPO is effective for improving reasoning performance.
watch_item: The practical loss relies on approximations to the derived objective, so its performance may depend on how well the mismatch-correction weighting is implemented and tuned.
